_comment: Canonical model registry. Source of truth for Python (model_registry.py) and frontend (modelRegistry.ts). Canonical keys are versioned+capability. providers maps canonical -> per-provider id: 'claude_code' is the claude-agent-acp id (global.anthropic.*[1m]), 'acp' is the kiro-cli id (bare dotted, e.g. 'claude-opus-4.8', as advertised by 'kiro-cli chat --list-models'). window = context tokens. Aliases include each provider id's bare (prefix-stripped) form, e.g. 'claude-opus-4-8[1m]', because claude-agent-acp advertises bare ids without the 'global.anthropic.' prefix; listing them lets from_provider_id fold the advertised rows onto the canonical key so the dropdown does not show duplicates.

fable-5-1m.description: Most intelligent, demanding reasoning and agentic work

opus-4.8-1m._comment_aliases: claude-opus-4.6/-4.6-1m stay listed here as claude_code aliases ONLY so claude-agent-acp (which lacks a distinct Opus 4.6) folds them onto Opus 4.8. On the 'acp' (kiro) path Opus 4.6 is a DISTINCT real model with its own canonical entry (opus-4.6-1m) above.

opus-4.7-1m.description: Most capable for complex work, 1M context

sonnet-4.6-1m._comment_aliases: claude-sonnet-4.5/-4/haiku-4.5 stay listed as claude_code aliases ONLY so claude-agent-acp (which lacks those distinct models) still folds them onto Sonnet 4.6 for dropdown dedup + graceful downgrade. On the 'acp' (kiro) path they are DISTINCT real models with their own canonical entries above (haiku-4.5/sonnet-4.5/sonnet-4, 200K) — declared first so the per-provider acp index maps each kiro id to itself, not to this 1M canonical. See from_provider_id / _registry_window (provider-aware).
